metrics_definitions.mean_fee_drag: mean(gross_horizon_return-net_horizon_return); return drag including foregone earnings on entry fees, not actual fee cash/B
metrics_definitions.switch_rate: chosen product or CASH changes divided by periods-1; not dollar turnover

profile_policy: frozen synthetic user constraints; normalized wealth diagnostic, not an account simulation
selection_policy: top1_else_cash; full close and reopen each horizon; fees applied each period
